messages:
zoe: Quick report: Kotlin sample app shows dispatcher threads piling up when a suspend Retrofit call is cancelled via coroutine timeout on older Android images. Repro is tiny.

nick: Which versions? HTTP/2?

zoe: Retrofit 2.9.0 + OkHttp 4.9.x, default HTTP/2. Code: withTimeout(1200) { service.streamBig() } and readTimeout is disabled. Cancel leads to threads stuck in SocketInputStream.read on Android 8/9. Forcing Protocol.HTTP_1_1 fixes it locally.

rohan: Likely the HTTP/2 frame reader not being interrupted on older kernels. Two pragmatic fixes for CI/sample app docs: 1) force HTTP/1.1 for flaky device tests, 2) set a bounded readTimeout in CI, 3) ensure suspend adapter calls call.timeout().cancel() then call.cancel().

zoe: I tried ordering timeout.cancel() before cancel() and it helped but didn't fully remove the hang on Android 8.1 emulator. Will try OkHttp 5.x snapshot next. Opening an internal ticket with thread dump and tiny repo.

ci-bot: Device tests failed: android-8-emulator  symptom: dispatcher-thread-exhaustion. Logs: https://ci.internal/8888

nick: For onboarding docs add a short note: "If your app uses per-request coroutine cancellations on older Android images, prefer HTTP/1.1 in device tests or set bounded readTimeouts; consider upgrading to OkHttp 5.x."

zoe: Thanks, will attach repro to the ticket and update sample-app README with the note. :thumbsup:
